faq.q: Can the AI put my headline and price on the image?
faq.a: No. It creates the product scene with open space but does not render readable campaign text.

faq.q: What size are the ad images?
faq.a: The examples on this page use square feed images. Other placements may use different dimensions or crops.

faq.q: Can I test two scene options?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the audience and offer consistent so the scene is the main change between versions.

faq.q: Do I have to say my ad image was made with AI?
faq.a: Disclosure rules vary by platform, location and use. Follow the guidance shown in the ad tool for your campaign.

overview.d: Square product visuals give a feed concept a clear focal point while people scroll. Start with one product photo, choose one scene and leave part of the frame open. Product claims and offers come from your approved campaign details.
